name: The Travel Permit hides Sunstrider Isle and Ammen Vale from a session that cannot enter Outland (#6174)
contract: Report #6174: on a realm with Expansion = 0 every teleport into map 530 fails with 'Missing Burning Crusade'.
Player::TeleportTo refuses a map whose MapEntry::Expansion() is above the session's expansion, and Map.dbc gives
Outland (530) expansion 1, so a session with expansion 0 can never arrive at Sunstrider Isle or Ammen Vale.
Decision: map 530 stays closed on Expansion 0, so the Travel Permit 977028 (spell 1001088) offers only the
destinations its holder can enter. A level 1 Blood Elf and Draenei on expansion 0 see their faction's three
vanilla starts, while an Orc on expansion 2 still sees all four Horde starts with Sunstrider Isle last.
